chunks.text: # Global Language Academy - Courses, Pricing, and Enrollment Dynamics Catalog

## 1. Course Offerings Overview
Global Language Academy offers premier language training designed according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Our programs are tailored for individual students, working professionals, teens, and corporate teams seeking conversational fluency and official international certification.

[Available Language Programs:]
### Available Language Programs:
- **General English**: Levels A1 to C1. Focuses on speaking confidence, listening comprehension, grammar mastery, and real-world conversation.
- **Business & Professional English**: Levels B1 to C2. Geared towards executive communication, international negotiations, email writing, cross-cultural diplomacy, and pitch presentations.
- **French (Français)**: Levels A1 to C1. Follows the official CIEP / France Éducation International framework.
- **German (Deutsch)**: Levels A1 to B2. Aligned with the Goethe-Institut standards for academic migration,

- **German (Deutsch)**: Levels A1 to B2. Aligned with the Goethe-Institut standards for academic migration, Studienkolleg, and work visas.
- **Italian (Italiano)**: Levels A1 to B2. Dynamic cultural immersion and language acquisition.
- **Portuguese (Português Brasileiro)**: Levels A1 to B2. Business and everyday conversational fluency.
- **Spanish for Foreigners (Español)**: Levels A1 to C2. Intensive immersion for expatriates, tourists, and digital nomads.

chunks.section: Global Language Academy - Schedules, Modalities, and Campuses
chunks.text: # Global Language Academy - Schedules, Modalities, and Campuses

## 1. Class Schedules and Timetables

To accommodate working professionals and university students, Global Language Academy offers morning, evening, and weekend time blocks.

### A. Weekday Schedules (Monday to Thursday)
- **Early Morning Track (Madrugadores)**:
  - 6:30 AM to 8:30 AM (Colombia Time, UTC-5).
  - 4 days per week (Monday through Thursday), 2 hours per session (8 hours/week).
- **Morning Standard Track**:
  - 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM (Monday through Thursday).
- **Afternoon Track**:
  - 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM (Monday through Thursday).
- **Evening Executive Track (Nocturno)**:
  - 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM (Monday through Thursday).
  - Designed specifically for working executives and university students.

### B. Weekend Intensive Track (Saturday Immersion)
- **Saturday Intensive Schedule**:
  - 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM (5 continuous hours with a 20-minute coffee & conversation break).
  - Complete 60 class hours in 12 consecutive Saturdays.

### C. Private 1-on-1 Sessions Scheduling
- Custom schedule availability from Monday to Saturday between 6:00 AM and 9:00 PM.
- Rescheduling policy: Students may reschedule individual sessions with at least 12 hours prior notice without forfeiture.

---

## 2. Learning Modalities

Students can choose between three flexible delivery models:

### 1. In-Person On-Campus (Presencial)
Classes are delivered in modern, climate-controlled classrooms equipped with smart screens, acoustic isolation, and high-speed Wi-Fi.
- Max group size: 8 students per classroom.
- Complimentary coffee, tea, and study lounge access.

### 2. 100% Live Online (Virtual en Vivo)
Real-time interactive classes hosted on Zoom Education with digital whiteboards and breakout rooms.
- Real-time teacher interaction (not pre-recorded video lectures).
- Complete session recordings uploaded to the student portal within 2 hours of class completion.
- Unlimited 24/7 access to our AI-powered pronunciation lab and grammar practice modules.

### 3. Hybrid Blended (Híbrido)
- 50% on-campus workshops (speaking labs, debates, and group presentations) + 50% virtual live seminars.
- Ideal for hybrid workers and students commuting across the city.

---

## 3. Physical Campus Locations and Facilities

Global Language Academy maintains two flagship physical campuses in Colombia:

### Bogotá Flagship Campus:
- **Address**: Calle 63 # 9-45, Chapinero Central, Bogotá, Colombia.
- **Access**: 2 blocks from Calle 63 TransMilenio Station.
- **Facilities**: 14 smart classrooms, multi-language library, rooftop conversation café, and student coworking lounge.
- **Opening Hours**: Monday to Friday 6:00 AM - 9:00 PM | Saturdays 7:30 AM - 2:30 PM.

### Medellín Flagship Campus:
- **Address**: Carrera 43A # 7-50, El Poblado (near Parque del Poblado), Medellín, Colombia.
- **Access**: 10-minute walk from Poblado Metro Station.
- **Facilities**: 10 interactive classrooms, outdoor garden terrace for conversation clubs, and testing center.
- **Opening Hours**: Monday to Friday 6:30 AM - 8:30 PM | Saturdays 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM.

---

## 4. Attendance and Makeup Class Policies

- **Minimum Attendance**: 80% attendance is required to qualify for the end-of-level evaluation exam.
- **Justified Absences**: Up to 3 justified absences per module (medical excuse or certified work duty).
- **Free Makeup Sessions**: Students with justified absences receive two complimentary 45-minute 1-on-1 makeup tutoring sessions per quarter.

chunks.text: # Global Language Academy - Enrollment, Levels, and Official Certifications

## 1. CEFR Level Framework and Progression

Our curriculum adheres strictly to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Each full level consists of two 60-hour modules (A and B):

| CEFR Level | Title & Competence | Modules Included | Total Hours | Expected Outcome |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **A1** | Breakthrough / Beginner | A1.1 & A1.2 | 120 Hours | Basic greetings, personal details, immediate needs |
| **A2** | Waystage / Elementary | A2.1 & A2.2 | 120 Hours | Everyday situations, routine descriptions, shopping |
| **B1** | Threshold / Intermediate |

| A2.1 & A2.2 | 120 Hours | Everyday situations, routine descriptions, shopping |
| **B1** | Threshold / Intermediate | B1.1 & B1.2 | 120 Hours | Work & travel conversations, opinions, plans |
| **B2** | Vantage / Upper-Intermediate | B2.1 & B2.2 | 120 Hours | Complex professional discussions, technical fluency |
| **C1** | Effective Operational Proficiency | C1.1 & C1.2 | 120 Hours | Fluent academic debates, executive negotiation, idioms |
| **C2** | Mastery / Native-Level Precision | C2.1 & C2.2 | 120 Hours | Total mastery, nuanced literary and professional command |

chunks.section: 2. Free Placement Diagnostic Test (Prueba de Nivelación)
chunks.text:
## 2. Free Placement Diagnostic Test (Prueba de Nivelación)

Every prospective student is entitled to our **100% Free Online Diagnostic Placement Test**:
- **Format**: 45-minute adaptive test measuring Reading, Grammar, Listening, and a 10-minute online speaking interview with an academic assessor.
- **Results**: Delivered within 2 business hours via email and WhatsApp.
- **Validity**: Diagnostic recommendations remain valid for 90 days.
- **Cost**: Completely free ($0 COP) with zero obligation to enroll.

---

chunks.text:

Global Language Academy is an authorized preparatory center for world-renowned international examinations:

[Supported Certification Programs:]
### Supported Certification Programs:
1. **IELTS (International English Language Testing System)**:
   - Formats: Academic (university admissions) and General Training (immigration to Canada, UK, Australia).
   - Preparation Course: 40 hours of intensive strategy + 4 full computer-delivered mock tests with band score analysis.
2. **TOEFL iBT (Test of English as a Foreign Language)**:
   - Preparation Course: 40 hours focused on integrated speaking and academic writing.
3. **Cambridge English Qualifications**:
   - B2 First (FCE) and C1 Advanced (CAE).

## 4. Enrollment Procedure (Step-by-Step)

1. **Step 1 - Diagnostic**: Complete the free online placement test or select Beginner A1.1.
2. **Step 2 - Academic Advising**: Review suggested schedule and modality with your assigned advisor.
3. **Step 3 - Tuition Payment**: Settle payment securely online via PSE, Credit Card, or Bank Transfer.
4. **Step 4 - Onboarding**: Receive portal login credentials, join the course WhatsApp group, and access textbook downloads.

---

chunks.text:

- **Course Freezing (Congelación de Matrícula)**: Students facing work commitments, medical issues, or travel may freeze their course progress up to 2 times per year for a maximum total duration of 6 months at zero penalty cost.
- **Human Escalation Policy**: Billing disputes, custom corporate invoicing, special scholarship petitions, or refund requests
